explanation: The independent measurement is a real missed grasp, not unknown registration: the hand moved 0.0338745 m while bowl progress was 0.0000155986 m, with 0.033888 m attachment error. The closure receipt at frame 78 still showed jaw joint magnitude 0.0339842 m; it fell to 0.00117489 m during the lift. Thus command delivery was used too early as permission to lift, and the shallow rim overlap did not establish capture. This patch preserves the episode, saved tracker and measured failure. It permits one revised grasp only after fresh evidence of detached source support and finger separation, settles the jaws at a fixed measured pad pose before testing, and keeps independent object/hand motion as the retention gate. Retry candidates engage slightly below and inside the measured lip, with compatible correction tolerances. Locally authorized transport leases are resized to leave review and control capacity for placement verification; self-occlusion alone no longer forces repeated tiny legs. No success is asserted before execution.
interface:
Entry remains main(api), returning JSON-compatible completion_proposed and evidence. These are exact localized replacements, not a reset or a motion command.

Observation dependencies and executable gates:
1. Source and destination geometry: retain the existing measured source/deck/burner planes, circular widest-rim model, rigid bowl height/radius and deck footprint, with their provenance and heuristic component uncertainties. Current lip surfaces plus calibrated visible-boundary rays witness rim geometry; tabletop and burner samples witness separate support planes. Failed named measurements are checked through membership and measurement_errors. Another visible arc/view is requested when a fit is unavailable. World fixture priors are not detections; contact, displacement, inconsistent partial measurements or changed identity invalidate affected dependencies.
2. Failed-grasp recovery: the saved motion reference plus a fresh track/landmark update and actual robot states must first establish nonretention. Unknown registration never authorizes reopening. A previously retained object is not automatically reopened after slip. For an initial measured miss, at most two current reviews seek same-body identity, upright source support, separated fingers, and the local opening sweep. Obtainable rim/support samples and actual own finger bounds quantify the finger-above-rim gap; it must exceed rim-height uncertainty plus 4 mm. Contact, an observed blocker or contradictory shape stops recovery. Missing evidence uses different current samples/view, then reports the exact gap. Valid geometry from two reviews is combined only at the identical physical frame with consistent identity/support interpretation. One revised grasp is allowed.
3. Reopening and approach: reopening intent is checkpointed only after the detached-source gate. The stationary jaw lease must settle before the open-finger geometry is used. Approach still obtains fresh partial rim agreement and local entry authorization; no later route certificate is required. Retry candidates derive from the measured radius, actual opening axis, pad extent and finger/support clearance, not fixed world coordinates. They are 0.5 or 0.65 pad half-heights below the lip and slightly inward, subject to the existing geometry and visual entry checks.
4. Insertion and closure: current local lip/hand evidence supplies the next predicate, not a full object registration. A consistent short-horizon source circle may be retained under partial occlusion; unknown or contradictory geometry invokes the existing saved-patch update or a new rim arc. Vertical overlap now uses the actual measured lip height even for an intentionally lowered pad target. Tangential overlap, radial alignment, support gap and uncertainty margins remain separate. The retry must also reach its deeper target within a componentwise centering tolerance; its drive tolerance is at most 1 mm, below that stopping threshold. Two correction leases remain bounded, with no repeated stalled push. Nominal overlap permits only a reviewed trial, not a contact claim.
   Close/open delivery and jaw settlement are different claims. Up to eight stationary control calls preserve the initial measured pad target and orientation. Settlement requires at least nine acknowledged requested-gripper steps and two successive joint changes below 0.4 mm, with pad drift below 3 mm and no stall. Intent, call count, actual command, qpos and settlement are checkpointed before later sensing can fail. A settled jaw, including an empty closed jaw, is not grasp evidence.
5. Retention and envelope: after settled closure, the existing locally justified lift compares independent patch/landmark motion with actual hand motion through geo.attachment_error and progress bounds. Persisted handles require fresh track_update quality checks. Unknown registration requests saved semantic correspondences, rejects ambiguity, or initializes another same-body patch for a new prospective test. No old rim registration is required merely to initialize that differential reference. Later transport-envelope propagation separately requires the measured patch/envelope relation and adequate orientation observability; otherwise current rim geometry is obtained. The existing three-test cap is not reset by regrasp.
6. Transfer and release: the current transported envelope, actual hand bounds and stationary fixture prior support only the next reviewed leg. Horizontal legs are at most 85 mm with a 12-call lease; upward and genuinely unobserved-space legs retain their smaller bounds. Self-occlusion alone does not shorten an otherwise supported leg. Observed external obstruction, no observed obstruction and unknown space remain different outcomes. The method neither certifies a full corridor nor moves through an observed blocker. Each completed leg still compares independently observed bowl motion with hand motion. Stalls preserve the jaws. Current footprint containment and bottom/support gap gate lowering, followed by actual post-lowering review and the existing bounded support/small-drop release alternatives.
7. Final assessment: opening must settle, then retreat changes the view. Two fresh world-geometry observations, separated by physical steps, must show the same upright bowl on the stove, bounded drift and compatible footprint/support height. Missing evidence is not success or a reason to regrasp. Completion remains a proposal, not native evaluation.

Persistence is bounded: one bowl_v2 checkpoint retains the existing reference handle, provenance, semantic definitions, shape/envelope binding and phase dependencies, plus one failed-test summary, one retry geometry/partial record and one jaw-settlement record. There is no nested history growth; the diagnostic window remains eight entries. Historical state is revalidated rather than discarded because Python restarted. API arguments and added return-key accesses have been audited against the supplied manual; all review fields are explicitly typed and their enum meanings are stated. No force sensing, hidden object state, collision certificate or calibrated confidence guarantee is introduced.
jev_protocol:
The existing seven Jev control questions are retained unchanged: x,y,z,rx,ry,rz each select negative/decrease, hold/within_tolerance or positive/increase for the host-bound world-axis residual; gripper selects exactly open, close or keep from objective.gripper. Quaternions remain xyzw. Python calculates geometry, signed target residuals, margins, tolerances and finite leases; Jev chooses semantic directions, not contact or success.

Ordinary motion uses api.drive, with each update invoking api.control and dispatching Jev's choices unchanged. Phase, numeric pad target, measured shape/support uncertainty and latest local authorization remain processed features. Revised transport leases permit up to 12 calls for an independently reviewed horizontal leg no longer than 85 mm. Unknown external space retains a shorter leg only when locally justified; an observed obstruction is not treated as clearance.

Jaw settling uses direct api.control at one saved pad_center target and orientation, with translation_limit=0.001, rotation_limit=0.01, steps=3, position_tolerance=0.001 and rotation_tolerance=0.04. Features explicitly identify stationary jaw settling as not contact or retention evidence. Actual selected gripper commands, acknowledged steps, measured qpos changes and pad displacement determine settlement; neither elapsed steps nor a reached receipt establishes a grasp. Reached/moved may support a settled stationary jaw when the measured checks pass; stalled stops the lease. Call counts persist across repairs.

Reviews remain separate real image observations with declared fields and named RGB-D measurements. The added recovery review uses body, model, relation, rim_camera, rim_pixels, separation and external only. fingers_above_bowl means detached fingers above an independently supported source bowl; contact_or_held forbids opening; unknown requests alternative evidence. none_observed is never certified clearance. Source support plus the independent failed motion test and numeric finger gap authorizes reopening, not Jev's interpretation of an image. After the revised closure, independent measured object/robot differential motion still decides retention.
